title: Project Hail Mary
description: Ryland Grace wakes up millions of miles from home, alone on a ship built by every space agency on Earth, with two dead crewmates and no memory of who he is or why he's there. As the fog lifts, the picture resolves into something worse than he could have imagined: he's the last-chance mission's sole survivor, and the assignment still falls to him. Humanity faces an extinction-level threat, and the only person left to stop it is a man who can't even remember his own name. His memories return in fragments, each one sharpening the impossible task ahead — until an unexpected ally changes the odds. A scientific mystery and an interstellar survival story rolled into one, built on real physics and the kind of problem-solving that turns certain doom into a slim, stubborn chance.
